name: TWAS-DBT Postdoctoral Fellowship
funder: TWAS (The World Academy of Sciences) and Department of Biotechnology, India
amount: Rs 61,000/month + HRA + Rs 600/month health insurance + Rs 50,000/year contingency; TWAS lump sum toward travel
other_rules: Nationals of a developing country other than India
maximum age 45 on 31 December of the application year
regularly employed in a developing country and committed to return
no residence visa for India or a developed country
one TWAS/OWSD fellowship application per year
notes: TWAS says no call will open in 2026; last call closed 19 Mar 2024. 12-18 months at an Indian biotech institution. TWAS-CSIR and TWAS-SN Bose run similar schemes.
